name: – After § 2 – Am 41
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 2a. Points to the Draghi report on the future of European competitiveness, which demonstrates that only a residual share of all emissions trading system (ETS) auctioning revenues goes towards decarbonisation investments in industries, and to the energy-intensive industries in particular; calls on the Commission to consider introducing the new optional mechanism into the system in order to directly link the cost of clearing ETS allowances (EUAs) to investment in clean technologies; suggests that this mechanism would allow the company to choose either to purchase the required amount of EUAs or to invest the equivalent amount of its funds in clean technology projects of its own that have been agreed and pre-approved by the Commission;
